title: LlmUsage
description: Settings of the llm-usage module, at modules.llm-usage: subscription plan-usage limits for Claude Code and Codex accounts.

claude.description: Claude Code (Claude.ai Pro/Max) usage; presence enables the Claude panel.

credentialsFile.description: Read-only path to a Claude Code .credentials.json; enables the OAuth usage backfill. Never written or refreshed by deck.

transcriptsDir.description: Optional read-only path to a Claude Code projects directory for the token-count transcript scan.

statusLine.description: statusLine hook ingest; the route exists only when the credential is set.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding the ingest bearer token, never its value.

activeInterval.description: ISO-8601 OAuth poll interval while a session is active; clamped to at least PT2M.

idleInterval.description: ISO-8601 OAuth poll interval while idle; clamped to at least PT2M.

codex.description: Codex (ChatGPT subscription) usage; presence enables the Codex panel.

codexHome.description: Read-write CODEX_HOME holding auth.json (the app-server refreshes it); mount the host's ~/.codex at the same path so its absolute symlinks resolve.

command.description: Codex executable path as deck sees it; defaults to codex on PATH. The deck image ships no codex: mount the host's Linux binary and point this at it.

rolloutDir.description: Optional rollout sessions directory; defaults to <codexHome>/sessions.

thresholds.description: Percent-used bands for warn and danger tones.

warn.description: Percent used at which a bar turns warn; default 75.

danger.description: Percent used at which a bar turns danger; default 90.

idlePause.description: ISO-8601 duration without a viewer after which upstream polling pauses; default PT5M.
